source.notes: Characterization baseline for the current math defects: the defuddle candidate strips the annotation encoding attribute and moves TeX into data-latex, so inline math loses its $...$ markers and duplicates its text, and a standalone block equation is dropped because the section selector does not include math. Expectations here must be regenerated when the parser fixes math output. See knowledge-reader-flutter/doc/rendering-layer.md section 4.6.

markdownIncludes: An inline formula such as score = relevance score = relevance must keep its TeX source
